title: 💳 Why Do I Need to Pay Twice?
content:
🌟 Simple explanation

When you buy products from China through our website, the process has two main stages:

1. 🛒 Stage 1: Buying the product from the Chinese seller

We help you purchase the product from platforms such as 1688, Taobao, Weidian, or other Chinese marketplaces.

This stage happens inside China.

2. ✈️ Stage 2: Shipping the product from our China warehouse to your country

After the item arrives at our China warehouse, you can submit it for international shipping.

This stage happens after the item has arrived at the warehouse.

Because these two stages involve different costs, they are paid separately.


1. 🛍️ First payment: Product purchasing fee

The first payment is made when you submit a shopping order.

This payment is mainly used to buy the product from the Chinese seller.

It may include:

  • Product price
  • Domestic shipping fee within China
  • Service fee, if applicable
  • Other purchasing-related fees, if applicable

After you complete this payment, we will start purchasing the product for you.


2. 🚚 What happens after the first payment?

After your first payment is confirmed, we will place the order with the Chinese seller.

Then the seller will ship the product to our China warehouse.

During this stage, the order may go through several statuses, such as:

  • Paid
  • Purchasing
  • Purchased
  • Seller Shipped
  • Waiting for Warehouse Arrival
  • Warehoused

Once the item arrives at our warehouse, you can check the item information and prepare it for international shipping.


3. 📦 Why is international shipping not included in the first payment?

International shipping cannot usually be calculated accurately before the item arrives at our warehouse.

This is because the final shipping fee depends on several details that are only known after warehouse processing.

For example:

  • The actual weight of the item
  • The package size
  • Whether the seller’s packaging is large or small
  • Whether you want to combine multiple items
  • Whether you need repacking or reinforcement
  • Which shipping method you choose
  • Which country or region the parcel will be shipped to
  • Whether the item is a normal item or a restricted item

Because of this, the international shipping fee is calculated after the item arrives at our warehouse.


4. 💰 Second payment: International shipping fee

The second payment is made when you submit your items for international shipping.

This payment is used to ship your parcel from our China warehouse to your destination country or region.

It may include:

  • International shipping fee
  • Packaging or repacking fee, if applicable
  • Reinforcement fee, if requested
  • Extra photo fee, if requested
  • Special handling fee, if applicable
  • Customs or tax-related fees, depending on the shipping method

After you complete the second payment, our warehouse will arrange packing and dispatch.


5. 📏 How is the second payment calculated?

The international shipping fee is usually calculated based on:

  • Destination country or region
  • Shipping method
  • Actual weight
  • Package size
  • Chargeable weight
  • Product type
  • Extra services
  • Shipping route rules

Some shipping methods charge by actual weight.
Some shipping methods may charge by volume weight if the package is large.

For example, a large but lightweight item may cost more to ship because it takes up more space during transportation.


6. 📦 Example: How two payments work

Here is a simple example.

You want to buy a jacket from China.

First payment

This payment may include:

  • Jacket price
  • Domestic shipping fee from the seller to our warehouse
  • Service fee

After this payment, we purchase the jacket for you.

Warehouse stage

The jacket arrives at our China warehouse.

Our warehouse checks the item, updates the status, and measures the package.

Second payment

You submit the jacket for international shipping.

The system calculates the shipping fee based on the package weight, size, destination country, and selected shipping method.

After you pay the international shipping fee, we ship the parcel to you.


7. 🧾 Does the first payment include everything?

Usually, no.

The first payment is mainly for product purchasing.

It usually does not include:

  • International shipping fee
  • Customs duties
  • Import taxes
  • Final parcel packaging cost
  • Optional warehouse services
  • Destination country fees

Please check the payment page carefully before paying.


8. 🌍 Will I need to pay customs duties or taxes?

It depends on your destination country and the shipping method you choose.

Some shipping methods may include tax handling.
Some shipping methods do not include import duties or taxes.

If your country’s customs or local courier charges import taxes, you may need to pay them separately.

Customs duties and import taxes are usually charged by the destination country, not by our website.


9. ✅ Why this payment method is better for users

Paying in two stages helps make the final cost more accurate.

It allows you to:

  • Buy products first
  • Wait for all items to arrive at the warehouse
  • Combine multiple items into one parcel
  • Choose the shipping method later
  • Decide whether to add extra services
  • Pay shipping based on actual package information

This is usually more flexible than paying an inaccurate international shipping fee at the beginning.


Important notes

  • The first payment is usually for product purchasing only.
  • The second payment is usually for international shipping.
  • International shipping is calculated after the item arrives at our China warehouse.
  • Final shipping cost depends on actual weight, package size, destination, and shipping method.
  • Customs duties or import taxes may not be included in the shipping fee.
  • Please check all fees carefully before making payment.
  • If you are unsure about the total estimated cost, please contact customer service before placing your order.


Frequently Asked Questions

Q1: Why can’t I pay everything at once?

Because the final international shipping fee is not known before the item arrives at our warehouse. We need to know the actual weight, package size, destination country, and shipping method before calculating the final shipping fee.

Q2: I already paid for the product. Why hasn’t it been shipped to my country?

The first payment only allows us to purchase the item from the Chinese seller. After the item arrives at our warehouse, you still need to submit it for international shipping and pay the international shipping fee.

Q3: Can I estimate the international shipping fee before buying?

Yes. You can use the shipping fee estimator if available, or contact customer service with the product link, quantity, and destination country. Please note that the estimate is for reference only. The final fee is based on the actual package information.

Q4: Can I combine items before paying the second fee?

Yes. After multiple items arrive at the warehouse, you can select them and submit them together for international shipping. Combining items may help reduce shipping costs in some cases.

Q5: What happens if I do not pay the second fee?

If the international shipping fee is not paid, the parcel will remain in the warehouse and will not be shipped internationally. Please also pay attention to the free storage period to avoid storage fees.

Q6: Are customs duties included in the second payment?

Not always. Some shipping methods may include tax handling, while others do not. Please check the shipping method details before submitting your parcel.


Need help?

If you are unsure about the payment process, please contact our customer service team before placing your order.

To help us assist you faster, please provide:

  • Your destination country
  • Product link or screenshot
  • Estimated quantity
  • Your order number, if available
  • Your question about the payment or shipping fee

We will help you understand the estimated cost and the next steps.
